activities.title: Lab 1 Part C: ask an AI, save the answer
activities.intro: Use any free AI assistant and your master folder from Part A. Tick each step as you finish it. No names, TINs or office data in the prompt.

items: Open a free AI assistant: Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT or Meta AI.
Type: List 3 ways AI helps with organizing office files
Read the answer. Is each idea sensible? Anything to double-check?
Copy the answer into Notepad (or Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice Writer).
Add one line: My note: the most useful idea, and why.
Save it in 02 AI Responses as YYYY-MM-DD AI Response - Organizing Files.

blocks.prompt: Which folder did you save your AI response in?
Which of these must never go into your prompt? Pick all that apply.
Copy your "My note" line here: the most useful idea, and why.

help: Asked to sign in? A personal account is fine, or try another tool.
Got an error or a refusal? Try another topic: a household budget, a sari-sari store, a kids' science project.

activities.title: Lab 1: File Management and Everyday AI
activities.intro: Hand in your Lab 1 master folder. It should have your name, two clearly named sub-folders, your BIR website screenshot from Part B and your AI response with your note from Part C. Missing something? Go back to Part A, B or C now.

items: A master folder with your name, on the Desktop
At least two clearly named sub-folders
One screenshot or downloaded image inside a sub-folder (Part B)
One text document with an AI response and your note (Part C)
File names follow YYYY-MM-DD Type - Subject

blocks.prompt: Upload your master folder as a ZIP file (right-click the folder › Compress to ZIP file), or a screenshot of it open in File Explorer.

activities.title: Digital Foundations Quiz
activities.intro: 10 items, 1 point each. Pick the one best answer for each item. Everything on it was covered in Topics 1.1 to 1.5.

blocks.prompt: 2. A scanner that turns a signed form into a file is what kind of hardware?
3. Which file name is easiest to find and sort?
4. You pressed Delete on a file on your Desktop by mistake. Where can you get it back?
5. In https://www.bir.gov.ph/index.php, which part tells you who owns the site?
6. Which search finds only PDF files from Philippine government websites?
7. A text says your account will be closed unless you send the OTP now. Best response?
options: Reply and ask who they are
Don't reply or click; verify officially and report it
Forward it to the office group chat

blocks.prompt: 9. Which of these uses AI that learned from examples?
10. What is the safe way to use a public AI chatbot at work?
options: Paste a taxpayer's return and ask for a summary
Ask for a generic template, then check and edit it
Copy its answer straight into an official letter
Give it your office login so it can read your email
